--- export const freeComponent = true; import Text from "@/components/fundations/typography/Text.astro"; const faqs = [ { question: "What is Oxbow and how can it help my team?", answer: "Oxbow is a collaborative workflow platform that centralizes tasks, files, and communication in one intuitive interface, so your team stays aligned and productive.", }, { question: "Is there a free trial or plan available?", answer: "Yes, we offer a 7-day free trial with full access to all features, plus a free plan for small teams to get started at no cost.", }, { question: "How secure is my data on Oxbow?", answer: "We use industry-standard encryption for data at rest and in transit, with regular security audits to ensure your information is always protected.", }, { question: "Can I integrate Oxbow with other tools I already use?", answer: "Absolutely! Oxbow supports integrations with Slack, Google Drive, Zapier, and more—so you can keep your existing workflows connected.", }, { question: "How do I upgrade to a paid plan?", answer: "Upgrading is simple: just visit the Billing section in your account settings, choose a plan that fits your needs, and you’ll be all set.", }, ]; ---
Got questions?
We’ve got answers. Here’s everything you need to know to get the most out of Oxbow.
